args.title: Fix README to replace npm run serve with correct start command
args.body:
File: README.md

The README's "Running locally" section instructs users to run "npm run serve" to start the API. However, this script does not exist in package.json, causing the "Missing script: serve" error.

The change proposes to correct the README by replacing "npm run serve" with the actual command to start the API, which appears to be "npm run start" or a similar valid script. This will enable users to run the API locally without error.
